svg.title: EpochGuard architecture and two deterministic safety stories
svg.desc: A one-page architecture diagram showing the presentation-only browser dashboard, four production APIs, the dual-scenario service, independent Normal and Impossible EpochStores, three shared real Role Agents with server-built Evidence Packs, the server-side Joint Validity Validator and Effect Gate, and the sole Mock Publish Effect outlet. The Normal story produces one effect. The Impossible story has three ALLOW decisions but no common valid cut, produces zero effects, and refreshes only Budget.

g.text: Prove a common world before the only effect
Renders one server revision at a time
Routes each session to one isolated partition
SHARED REAL ROLE AGENTS · CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS UNTRUSTED
The same registered triple serves either scenario; each run is separately bound.
server-built · assignment-scoped · Receipt + interval + hash; Agent reads, never authorizes
and Stores cannot append an Effect.
Effect Gate is the one write path.
No permit / stale head / No-Cut ⇒ zero effects
HEAD 10 · THREE ALLOW DECISIONS SHARE ONE CUT
Commit crosses the sole Effect Gate → Mock Publish Effect appended exactly once.
HEAD 21 · THREE TRUE-at-observation ALLOWs, NO SHARED CUT
L=21 · U=20 · U≤L → No-Cut Proof → Gate LOCKED
Refresh plan re-observes Budget only; final current cut is consistent DENY, still effect=0.
EpochGuard architecture · production surface + deterministic demo contracts · no external assets or runtime script
Browser displays · Agents propose · Server proves · Gate alone effects
